answer: Each identity starts its voyage with a 50 POA escrow deposit and a named referrer on the graph. A canyon of cost separates cheap fakes from trusted ones: the deposit hides behind a cipher only the depositor knows, and for 10 epochs any peer may dispute it. A jury of 5 rules; if fake, the deposit burns and the referrer loses equally. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA; an honest agent pays once, is refunded, rewards undiluted.
